_note: Lenskart reports two Ind AS 108 geographical segments: India (stores, online and the Indian manufacturing/supply chain; includes inter-segment sales to International) and International (Owndays Japan/Asia, Lenskart Singapore/SE Asia, Middle East, Meller from FY26). Segment EBITDA here = segment profit + depreciation + share of associates' loss (AR FY26 note 41), i.e. after Ind AS 116 (rent excluded) and after allocated ESOP cost; the company also quotes 'EBITDA (pre-IndAS 116)' after rent. Quarterly figures are the company's proforma basis (Dealskart, GeoIQ and Meller consolidated in both years; from Q3FY26 proforma = reported). FY23-FY24 segment revenue/EBITDA were not in our sources (pre-IPO annual reports show one segment); stores are from the RHP via ICICI Direct's IPO note.

src.annual: AR FY26 consolidated note 41 (segment information, FY26 and FY25), https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachHis/8e2ed7da-009b-445a-a327-2b18794d0b02.pdf (AR dated 20-May-2026; filed before the AGM); stores FY23-25 RHP via ICICI Direct IPO note (30-Oct-2025) https://www.icicidirect.com/mailcontent/idirect_lenskartsolutions_iponote-oct_25.pdf; FY26 stores and SSSG: Q4FY26 shareholders' letter (20-May-2026) https://assets.lenskart.com/documents/2026/05/20/ShareholderResult-Q4-2026.pdf

Prior-year quarters derived from the stated growth rates and margins.

_noteEsop: indiaEbitdaPreEsop / intlEbitdaPreEsop add back ESOP cost: the standalone (Lenskart Solutions Ltd) charge to India and the rest of the consolidated charge to International (an approximation: Indian subsidiaries such as Dealskart sit in the remainder). The model forecasts segment EBITDA before ESOP and deducts the consolidated ESOP cost (esop array).
